path_hint: Drop the app here or paste a path
st_not_ym: This is not the supported music app
info_retry: rate limited by the service — retrying in {s} s
err_rate_limited: rate limited by the service — try again in a couple of minutes
st_not_found: App not found — choose it manually
log_fs_hook_ok: Saving: files are written by the music app
log_fs_hook_fail: Saving via the music app is unavailable ({err}) — switched to “via YaMu+”
dlg_file_name: File name (extension follows the track format)
st_mode_restart: Saving mode will change after the music app restarts
log_fs_wrapper: Saving: files are written by YaMu+ (chosen in the YaMu+ window)
chk_tray_launch: Minimize to tray when the music app starts
chk_tray_launch_mac: Hide to menu bar when the music app starts
st_lang_restart: The language inside the music app will change after it restarts
log_replaced: Closed the previously running YaMu+ build (along with its music app)
help_items:
“Save locally” in a track’s ⋯ menu saves the track to a file.
“Save locally” in an album’s, single’s or playlist’s ⋯ menu saves its tracks to a folder.
“Delete downloads” in an album’s, single’s or playlist’s ⋯ menu deletes its tracks downloaded inside the music app.
st_store_unsupported: This is Yandex Music from the Microsoft Store — it is not supported. Use the version from the Yandex Music website
st_store_only: Only Yandex Music from the Microsoft Store was found — it is not supported. Install the version from the Yandex Music website
st_hook_failed: YaMu+ cannot work with Yandex Music {ver} — see the log for details
log_hook_failed: YaMu+ cannot work with Yandex Music {ver}: {err}
st_save_failed: Saving failed — see the log for details
